specs.title: description and optional note survive a failed save without changing exact money
literal homepage uses the same React screen with isolated reference figures
calculated account shares round the exact ratio once
transfer date can be cleared and restored without a false balance or lost precision
balance privacy and transaction selection preserve access to edit actions
account, goal and budget chevrons retain deletion confirmation without issuing writes
chart and account period controls change the actual report
budget management opens the existing form and preserves unsaved exact limits
long desktop account records wrap without overlap or page overflow
